newsitem.title: USA: California refiners see highest margins in a year.
newsitem.headline: California refiners see highest margins in a year.

text.p: Refinery margins in California rose to their highest level in a year in early April, according to the latest Salomon Brothers report on West Coast oil sector.
West Coast margins have already reached $8.80 a barrel, compared to an average of $9.00 a barrel for the entire second quarter 1996 .
"We expect to see continued strength in California refining," said Ting, head of Salomon's energy research, in his weekly refining report.
Margins benefited from low regional gasoline inventories, which last week stood 2.3 million barrels below year ago levels, according to a supply report from the American Petroleum Institute.

"Gasoline inventory is still relatively low," Ting told Reuters, noting that the year's heaviest demand lay ahead and that refiners were still bringing production up to full tilt following months of shutdowns for maintenance.
Ting expects California's margins to exceed the 1996 average of $6.42 a barrel, but doubts they will move into double-digit territory.

Since last year, price spikes have become more likely because of California's unique type of gasoline, an ultraclean blend that few other refiners in the world can send to the state should supplies suddenly drop, Ting said.
"During periods of planned and unplanned maintenance you're likely to see strong run-ups in margins," he said.
California refining profits have also strengthened following the end of a costly price war that was designed to boost market share late last year.
California's gasoline production has kept narrowly ahead of demand, with consumption of 980,000 barrels-per-day (bpd) of gasoline running just under the one million bpd produced.

That demand could attract shipments from the only two refiners outside California that make California-grade gasoline in the world, Amerada Hess Corp's 545,000 bpd plant at St. Croix in the Virgin Islands, and Valero's 29,900 bpd plant in Corpus Christi, Texas.
